description.value: You clench your fist and crush the breath from a creature's throat with the dark side. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d8 force damage and is restrained and unable to speak for the duration as your grip holds firm; it can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a success, it merely takes half damage.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 1
